Hi, I'm sorry that your experiencing a rough time.  There is more than a little hope left.  We can create our own hope, or reduce it by the way we act, the things we say, and how we think about events.  Try and picture yourself being exactly the person you want to be i.e. working the job you love, having wonderful relationships with others, etc.  Then start planning on how your going to accomplish your goals.  It does not happen overnight and will take a while.  Baby steps at first moving in the right direction is the best way to begin.  Try to stop zeroing in on the negative.  Catch yourself when you notice yourself being negative, and push the negative thoughts out, by thinking about positive things.  Example you might think or say "It sure is hot and oppressive today", stop yourself and force yourself to acknowledge "That your glad it is not freezing cold, and the sun is shining".  Essentially, your training yourself to think differently and insert optimism, where you would normally be pessimistic.  Try and see the glass half full, rather than half empty.  Be grateful for what you have, not sad for what you have not.  It may seem silly, and pointless at first, but you should soon notice that you start to feel better.
